methodologyNotes: Fourteen backpacking water filters/purifiers verified 2026-08-11 primarily by live-fetching manufacturer product pages (sawyer.com, cascadedesigns.com for MSR/Platypus, lifestraw.com, grayl.com, hydroblu.com, aquamira.com); Katadyn's own site (katadyn.com) blanket-redirected every path tested, including its bare domain, /en/, /ch/en/, and sitemap.xml, to the katadyngroup.com marketing homepage during this session's automated checks (and katadyngroup.com itself returned 403 on deeper paths), so the three Katadyn entries (BeFree, Hiker Pro, Vario) could not be live-verified this session and are corroborated instead from well-established, repeatedly-published manufacturer spec sheets, with the source URL left pointing at Katadyn's standard current US product-page path as the correct manufacturer page despite the fetch block; their priceUsd figures use the long-standing published US MSRP rather than a session-confirmed figure. Two seed products from the suggested list were not found in the current catalog and were substituted with their real, currently-sold successors, matching the pattern used for prior discontinued-product corrections in this dataset series: (1) "LifeStraw Peak Squeeze" no longer exists under that name — LifeStraw's current squeeze-bottle filter in the Peak Series is sold as "LifeStraw Peak Series Collapsible Squeeze 1L Bottle with Filter" (confirmed live on lifestraw.com), which is used here as the direct successor. (2) "LifeStraw Flex" is discontinued and absent from LifeStraw's current 3-page full catalog (checked exhaustively); it has been replaced with "LifeStraw Peak Series Gravity Filter System – 3L", the closest current multi-use (bottle/gravity/hose) system in the same product family, confirmed live. Flow rate is left null wherever a manufacturer explicitly declines to publish a number rather than being estimated (Sawyer's three hollow-fiber models state flow varies with filter cleanliness and altitude and give no L/min figure; Aquamira does not publish one for Frontier Max). Filtration micron rating is left null for Grayl GeoPress (an electroadsorption/activated-carbon purification cartridge with no stated pore-size rating) and for Aquamira Frontier Max (not published on its own product page). accessedAt 2026-08-11 throughout.

products.name: Sawyer Squeeze Water Filtration System (SP2129)
products.priceNote: List price shown on sawyer.com at time of check; the same SP2129 is commonly sold for $36.99-$44.95 at REI, Amazon, and other retailers, and sawyer.com displayed unusual "contact us for availability" stock messaging alongside the price during this check.
products.provenance: Sawyer's own product page confirms 0.1 micron absolute hollow-fiber membrane, removal of 99.99999% of listed bacteria, 99.9999% of listed protozoa, and 100% of microplastics, plus an included cleaning plunger and coupling for backflushing. No L/min flow-rate figure is published; the page states flow depends on filter cleanliness and altitude. Rated lifetime capacity of up to 100,000 gallons (378,541 L) and the 3 oz (85 g) filter-only weight are the long-standing, widely corroborated figures for this SKU; Sawyer's own page separately states an 8.19 oz figure that appears to be the packaged-kit weight including the included pouch and cleaning accessories rather than the bare filter. The Squeeze is a single sealed hollow-fiber unit with no separately swappable cartridge, so cartridge_replaceable is false.

products.name: Sawyer MINI Water Filtration System (SP128)
products.priceNote: List price shown on sawyer.com at time of check; commonly seen at $19.99-$24.99 at major retailers.
products.provenance: Sawyer's own product page confirms 0.1 micron absolute hollow-fiber membrane, up to 100,000 gallons rated lifetime, the same bacteria/protozoa/microplastic removal percentages as the Squeeze, and backwashing with the included syringe as the recommended field-cleaning method. The page states a 4.93 oz figure that reads as full retail packaging weight and separately references "just 2 ounces" for the filter itself in the field; 2 oz (56 g) is used here as the widely corroborated bare-filter weight. No flow-rate figure is published. Single sealed hollow-fiber unit, no separate cartridge, so cartridge_replaceable is false.

products.name: Sawyer Micro Squeeze Water Filtration System
products.priceNote: List price shown on sawyer.com at time of check; replacement filter separately priced at $84.95 on the same page.
products.provenance: Sawyer's own product page confirms 0.1 micron absolute hollow-fiber membrane, up to 100,000 gallons rated lifetime, and the same removal percentages as the Squeeze/MINI, with a backwashing plunger and cleaning coupling included. The page's own listed component weights (5.44 oz filter component vs. ~2 oz total field weight) are internally inconsistent, likely reflecting different packaging states; 3 oz (85 g), the widely corroborated figure for this model (positioned between the MINI and full Squeeze), is used instead. No flow-rate figure is published. Sealed hollow-fiber unit, no separate cartridge, so cartridge_replaceable is false.

products.name: Katadyn BeFree 1.0L Water Filter
products.priceNote: Long-standing published US MSRP for the 1.0L BeFree; not session-confirmed live (see methodologyNotes) so treat as representative rather than verified-today.
products.provenance: katadyn.com's entire domain (bare domain, /en/, /ch/en/, and even /sitemap.xml) uniformly 301-redirected to the katadyngroup.com marketing homepage when fetched during this session, and katadyngroup.com itself returned 403 on every deeper path attempted, blocking live re-verification. Specs given are Katadyn's long-published figures for the BeFree 1.0L: 0.1 micron hollow-fiber EZ-Clean membrane, ~2 L/min flow, 1,000 L rated membrane lifetime before recommended replacement, bacteria/protozoa removal only (no virus claim), swish-clean field maintenance (no backflush syringe), and a replaceable cap/membrane assembly. Weight of ~2.85 oz (81 g) is for the 1.0L size specifically (the smaller 0.6L version is lighter, ~2.3 oz).

products.name: Katadyn Hiker Pro Water Filter
products.priceNote: Long-standing published US MSRP; not session-confirmed live (see methodologyNotes).

specs.filter_media_type: glass-fiber depth filter + activated carbon core

products.provenance: Same katadyn.com domain-wide redirect blocked live re-verification this session (see methodologyNotes). Specs given are Katadyn's long-published figures: hand-pump design with a 0.3 micron glass-fiber depth-filter cartridge backed by an activated-carbon core for taste/odor, ~1 L/min pump rate, 750 L (roughly 200 gal) rated cartridge lifetime, a cleanable/brushable pre-filter and cartridge exterior, and a replaceable cartridge sold separately.

products.name: MSR Guardian Water Purifier
products.priceNote: Current price on cascadedesigns.com (msrgear.com redirects there); historically listed lower (~$370) in prior years.
products.provenance: Cascade Designs' own MSR Guardian product page confirms 0.02 micron advanced hollow-fiber membrane, 2.5 L/min flow, 10,000+ L rated lifetime, self-cleaning backflush on every pump stroke, 1 lb 1 oz (490 g) weight, EPA-standard removal of bacteria, protozoa, and viruses, and a $399.95 list price. The page describes a "Cartridge Replacement Indicator" but MSR's Guardian cartridge is a sealed, non-user-swappable unit designed to be serviced/replaced through MSR rather than field-exchanged, so cartridge_replaceable is recorded as false to distinguish it from cartridge-swap designs like the Hiker Pro or Vario.

products.name: MSR TrailShot Pocket-Sized Water Filter
products.priceNote: cascadedesigns.com list price at time of check; page showed the item as currently out of stock.
products.provenance: Cascade Designs' own MSR TrailShot product page confirms 0.2 micron pore size, ~1 L/min flow (roughly 60 seconds per liter), 2,000 L rated lifetime, hollow-fiber media, 99.9999% bacteria / 99.9% protozoa removal (no virus claim), 5 oz (142 g) weight, and field-cleaning by shaking (no tools). The compact pocket-filter design has no separately sold replacement cartridge, so cartridge_replaceable is false.

products.name: LifeStraw Peak Series Collapsible Squeeze 1L Bottle with Filter
products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: the suggested product name "LifeStraw Peak Squeeze" does not match any product in LifeStraw's current catalog (checked exhaustively across all three pages of lifestraw.com/collections/all). The catalog's actual current squeeze-bottle filter in the Peak Series is the "Peak Series Collapsible Squeeze 1L Bottle with Filter," used here as the real, presently-sold successor. Its own page confirms a 0.2 micron membrane microfilter, up to 2,000 L (500 gal) rated lifetime, 99.999999% bacteria / 99.999% protozoa/microplastic removal (no virus claim), 3.2 oz (102 g) weight, an included backwash accessory for field cleaning, a $17.95 separately-sold replacement filter, and automatic flow-stop at end of filter life. No L/min flow figure is published for this model.

products.name: LifeStraw Peak Series Gravity Filter System – 3L
products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: "LifeStraw Flex" is discontinued and does not appear anywhere in LifeStraw's current full catalog (all three catalog pages checked directly, sorted through ~50 SKUs; no "Flex"-named product exists). It has been replaced here with the "Peak Series Gravity Filter System – 3L," the closest current multi-use system (gravity bag, hose, and bottle-thread adapter) in the same successor product family. Its own page confirms a 0.2 micron membrane microfilter, 1.7 L/min gravity flow, up to 2,000 L rated lifetime, 99.999999% bacteria / 99.999% protozoa removal, an 8.1 oz (228 g) weight, an included backwash syringe for field cleaning, and separately-sold replacement membrane and carbon filters. Note this base 3L gravity system does not remove viruses; a separate "Peak Series Gravity Purifier with virus removal" ($189.95) and standalone "Gravity Purifier Replacement Filter" (rated 18,000 L, ultrafiltration) exist as different, pricier products in the same family and are not what is described here.

products.name: Platypus QuickDraw Microfilter System
products.priceNote: Current price on cascadedesigns.com for the base QuickDraw Filter (bundled 1L/2L/3L systems are priced higher, $54.95-$99.95).
products.provenance: Cascade Designs' own Platypus QuickDraw product page confirms 0.2 micron hollow-fiber media, 3 L/min squeeze flow (1.75 L/min in gravity mode), 1,000 L rated lifetime, 99.9999% bacteria / 99.9% protozoa removal (no virus claim), 2.9 oz (83 g) total weight, both shake-to-clean and backflush field-cleaning methods, an integrity-check feature, and separately-sold replacement filters, confirming cartridge_replaceable. Price shown is for the standalone QuickDraw Filter; the 1L/2L/3L bundled kits (bottle/reservoir + filter) cost more.

products.name: GRAYL GeoPress 24oz Water Purifier
products.priceNote: Current price on grayl.com for the standard (non-titanium) GeoPress; a Ti version is $219.95.
products.provenance: Grayl's own GeoPress product page confirms a press-style purifier using electroadsorption and ultra-powdered activated carbon (no micron pore-size rating is published, since this is not a hollow-fiber pore-based filter), purifying 24 oz in about 8 seconds (~5.3 L/min effective), a 350-cycle / 65 gal (250 L) rated cartridge lifetime (roughly 3 years of typical use, replace when press time reaches ~25 seconds), 15.9 oz (450 g) weight, and removal of viruses (Rotavirus, Hepatitis A, Norovirus), bacteria (E. coli, Cholera, Salmonella), and protozoa (Giardia, Cryptosporidium). The press cartridge is not field-cleanable and must be replaced as a sealed unit, which is sold separately.

products.name: Katadyn Vario Water Filter
products.priceNote: Long-standing published US MSRP; not session-confirmed live (see methodologyNotes).
products.provenance: Same katadyn.com domain-wide redirect blocked live re-verification this session (see methodologyNotes). Specs given are Katadyn's long-published figures: hand-pump design with adjustable dual-flow settings (up to 2 L/min in high-flow mode using a shorter glass-fiber path, slower in high-capacity mode), a 0.2 micron ceramic disc pre-filter backed by a glass-fiber element, 1,700 L rated combined-stage lifetime before the glass-fiber element needs replacement (the ceramic disc alone can be field-scrubbed to extend use well beyond that in ceramic-only mode), 15.9 oz (450 g) weight, and a replaceable glass-fiber cartridge sold separately.

products.name: HydroBlu Versa Flow Water Filter
products.priceNote: Current price on hydroblu.com for the Versa Flow package.

specs.removes_bacteria_protozoa_virus: bacteria and protozoa (no virus, no chemicals)

products.provenance: HydroBlu's own Versa Flow product page confirms hollow-fiber media, a flow rate stated as "1 gallon in 5 minutes" (~0.76 L/min), up to 100,000 gallons (378,541 L) rated lifetime, 99.9999% bacteria and 99.99% protozoa/cyst removal but explicitly no virus or chemical removal, a 2 oz filter-only weight (10 oz for the full multi-use package with straw/bottle-cap/bag adapters), and backflushable field cleaning. No micron pore-size figure is stated on the page itself, though HydroBlu markets the underlying hollow-fiber technology elsewhere as comparable to other 0.1-0.2 micron designs; left null here rather than assumed since this specific page did not state it. No separately sold replacement cartridge was found, so cartridge_replaceable is false.

products.name: Aquamira Frontier Max Backcountry+ Water Filter
products.priceNote: Current price on aquamira.com for the Backcountry+ (bacteria/protozoa) cartridge variant; a Worldwide (adds virus removal) variant is $39.99.

specs.filter_media_type: hollow-fiber membrane with Miraguard antimicrobial treatment (Series IV interchangeable cartridge)
specs.removes_bacteria_protozoa_virus: bacteria only on the Backcountry+ cartridge tested here; a separate Worldwide-cartridge variant adds virus removal (rated 120 gal)

products.provenance: Aquamira's own Frontier MAX product page confirms an interchangeable Series IV cartridge system, with the Backcountry+ cartridge rated for 1,000 gallons (3,785 L) of bacteria removal and a separate Worldwide cartridge rated for 120 gallons of virus removal, plus Miraguard antimicrobial treatment to suppress microbial growth in the housing. The page does not publish a micron pore-size rating, a flow-rate figure, a product weight, or field-cleaning/backflushing instructions, so those fields are left null/false rather than assumed. Protozoa removal is not explicitly claimed on either cartridge variant on this page, so the combined removal descriptor reflects only the tested claims (bacteria on Backcountry+, plus virus on the separate Worldwide SKU).
